name: nexus-business-manager
description: Nexus Business Manager — ERP SaaS multiempresa (reconstrução do zero).
author: Clayton Marcelo

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @nexus/api && npm run build --workspace @nexus/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @nexus/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @nexus/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @nexus/api && npm run test --workspace @nexus/web
scripts.docker:migrar: docker compose exec -T api node_modules/.bin/prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.docker:admin: docker compose exec -T api npm run admin:criar --workspace @nexus/api
